intro.h2: New cabinet faces without the tear-out
paragraphs: Cabinet refacing in Wilmington, NC is the main service at Newberry Home Improvement, the parent company of Kitchen Restylers. Installers apply a new veneer to the fronts and sides of your existing cabinet boxes, then swap in new doors, drawer fronts and hardware. Your countertop and sink can stay where they are.

You choose from more than 50 colors and 15 door styles, and the work usually takes 1 to 2 days. The company says refacing can cost 25 to 50 percent less than new cabinets. The same crews also handle new cabinets, Silestone quartz counters, and tub and shower updates from its North Kerr Avenue showroom.

services.h2: Kitchen and bath work, most of it finished within a week

items.name: Cabinet Refacing and Restyling
items.blurb: A new factory-finish surface goes over your cabinet sides and fronts, and every door and drawer front is replaced to match. Trim, crown and shoe molding can be added. Most jobs take 1 to 2 days, and a free inspection tells you whether your cabinets qualify.

image.alt: Kitchen refaced in Shaker style doors in Fashion Grey and White Satin with a dark island and bar stools

items.name: New Cabinets
items.blurb: When refacing is not the right fit, Newberry tears out the old cabinets and installs new custom-made ones with soft-close hinges and glides. Add rollout shelves, trash rollouts or lazy Susans. New cabinets with a countertop can be done in as little as 3 days.

image.alt: Replacement cabinets in Cottage style White Satin with glass-front uppers and a granite island with stools

items.name: Tub to Shower Conversion
items.blurb: Your old bathtub comes out and a low-threshold acrylic shower pan and wall surround go in, in 2 days. Seating, shelving and grab bars can be added. Acrylic resists cracking, chipping and mildew, and it is easier to step into than a tub.

image.alt: Tub to shower conversion with Calcutta stone-look acrylic walls, a low-threshold pan and chrome grab bar

items.name: Shower and Tub Replacement
items.blurb: Replace an old, moldy or leaking shower or a dated tub with Bellastone acrylic in earth tones, white, subway or marble looks. Representatives bring samples to your home, and full-size displays of a few colors are set up in the showroom.

image.alt: Replacement shower with subway tile-look acrylic walls, a glass door and black grab bar

items.name: Full Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Start with the tub or shower, then add a vanity, vanity top, sink, faucet, flooring, wainscoting and toilet as a package. Most full bath remodels take 4 to 5 days. You can also do the shower first and the rest later to spread out the cost.

image.alt: Beach house bathroom remodel with a subway-look acrylic shower, sliding glass door, wood vanity and blue walls

items.name: Countertops, Sinks and Faucets
items.blurb: As an authorized Silestone provider, Newberry installs quartz and granite counters along with sinks, faucets and tile backsplashes. When you also reface or replace cabinets, one crew coordinates the whole install so your kitchen is out of use for less time.

image.alt: Complete kitchen remodel with Shaker style cabinets in Almond, new countertops and stainless appliances

why_choose_us.h2: Why Cape Fear homeowners call Newberry

items.title: Two days, with the water tested overnight
items.text: Newberry will not rush a bath into one day. Its employee installers and plumbers test the water overnight before finishing, which is why tub and shower installs take 2 days.

items.title: The price you hear is the price you pay
items.text: You get exact pricing up front, with no hidden or tacked-on charges, and you know the final price before work starts. One reviewer said Newberry had the best price of three quotes.

items.title: A 7-year warranty backed by labor
items.text: Work comes with a 7-year warranty. If a product turns out to be defective, Newberry matches the manufacturer's warranty with full labor coverage, so you are not billed for the crew's time.

items.title: Back-to-back local award
items.text: WECT named Newberry Best of the Cape Fear in Kitchen and Bath Remodeling for both 2024 and 2025. The company is also BBB Accredited and holds 5.0 stars across 242 Google reviews.

about.h2: Led by Barry Dyer, staffed by installers clients name
about.text: Owner Barry Dyer has spent more than three decades in home improvement. He runs Newberry Home Improvement as the parent company of Kitchen Restylers, and keeps the company focused on kitchens and baths. Showrooms in Wilmington and Myrtle Beach let you see door styles and shower colors in person. The crews are employees, and Google reviewers name them often: JT, Austin and Jacob on cabinets, Kevin on a master bath, and Michael and Eric on a tub-to-shower swap. Clients mention punctuality, tidy work areas and a walkthrough of the warranty at the end.

image.alt: Newberry Home Improvement team outside the Wilmington, NC showroom with the WECT Best of the Cape Fear badge

process.h2: From free consultation to finished room

steps.title: Request pricing
steps.text: Call or send your name, city and phone. Newberry contacts you to set a free in-home consultation, days, evenings or some Saturdays.

steps.title: In-home visit and inspection
steps.text: A design consultant brings samples, inspects your cabinets for free to see if they qualify for refacing, and gives you an exact price up front.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: Refacing takes 1 to 2 days, new cabinets 2 to 3, a tub or shower 2, and most full baths 4 to 5 days.

steps.title: Walkthrough and warranty
steps.text: Installers clean up and go over the finished work and your warranty with you before they leave, as reviewers describe.

service_area.h2: Two showrooms covering coastal North and South Carolina
service_area.text: The Wilmington showroom on North Kerr Avenue serves southeastern North Carolina, from Wilmington up to Emerald Isle and New Bern and west to Lumberton. The Myrtle Beach office at 1732 US-501, (843) 970-2743, covers South Carolina from Florence to Murrells Inlet and up through Little River to Calabash. Wherever you live in that stretch of coast, a representative can bring door and shower samples to your home.

faq.h2: What Wilmington, NC homeowners ask about cabinet refacing

items.a: Most kitchens can be refaced without major issues. Sometimes one cabinet has to be fixed or replaced. A Newberry kitchen expert inspects your cabinets for free during the in-home visit. If the savings over new cabinets would be small for your kitchen, the inspection is also where they tell you replacing is the better choice.

items.q: Why does a shower install take 2 days instead of 1?
items.a: Newberry does not want to be in a hurry. Its employee installers and plumbers want the water tested overnight before the job is finished, so a new tub or shower is installed over 2 days. The company sees that extra night as a check that protects your home, not a delay.

items.q: How long does a full bathroom remodel take?
items.a: Most full bathroom remodels with a new tub or shower, vanity, top, sink, faucet, flooring, wainscoting and toilet take 4 to 5 days. Large bathrooms can take a day or two longer. You can also have the tub or shower done first and the rest later to split up the cost.

Yes. Financing is offered through Medallion Bank, with payments listed as low as $110 a month and other options available. Approval depends on credit, the loan terms are set directly between you and the lender, and rates vary with the size of the job. Ask about current terms at your consultation.

Projects are backed by a 7-year warranty. Newberry also matches the manufacturer's product warranty with a full labor warranty. If a product turns out to be defective, its suppliers trust Newberry to confirm the defect and replace the material, and you are not billed for the labor to swap it.

final_cta.h2: See your new kitchen colors at home
final_cta.text: Call 910-500-6811 to book a free in-home consultation. The Wilmington showroom is open Monday to Thursday 8:30 am to 4:30 pm and Friday 8:30 am to 4 pm.
